sharedRules.name: Dragon Situation Table (EC)
sharedRules.description:
[see pg. 12 in Chapter 4 Booklet for priority explanation]
- Not Engaged & Enemy model in LOS -> Fireball
- Enemy model within LOS and 6" -> Flame Breath
- Engaged with 1 model -> Slash
- Engaged with 2 models -> Stomp
- Engaged with 1 model -> Bite
- Engaged with 3+ models -> Sweep
- Not Engaged or Engaged -> Swipe
